name: led_chain
summary: A chain of addressable LEDs (WS2816C-1313), data from one to the next, with bypass capacitors
note: Each LED's DO feeds the next one's DI. The datasheet contradicts itself on capacitors (none needed, p.1; 100 nF suggested between VDD and GND, p.5): cap_every = 1 puts one by every LED, larger values one by every that-many. DI's thresholds are fractions of VDD, so a 3.3 V output can't drive a chain at a LiPo's 4.2 V directly (0.7 x 4.2 = 2.94 V): the level rule says so, and nfet_level_shift is the usual fix. The footprint is simple_earring's (library parts.pretty, vendored with the bolt earring); KiCad's LED:WS2812B symbol has the same pin numbers.

cap_every.note: One 100 nF capacitor per this many LEDs

requires.message: a chain has at least one LED

citations.quote: 1 VDD 电源 / 2 DO 数据输出 / 3 GND 地 / 4 DI 数据输入

citations.note: In the maximum-ratings table; no separate recommended range.

citations.quote: 可以在GND和VDD之间适当增加滤波电容（建议取值100nf）
citations.note: Optionally a filter capacitor between GND and VDD, 100 nF suggested. p.1 says no external components, capacitors included, are needed.
